description.text: Objectives The graduate program in Civil Engineering provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and research skills that allow them to handle the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of civil engineering. Students are expected to be able to engage in scientific research, and assume leadership role in the civil engineering industries. Duration Duration of program is between 1.5 to 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Innovative Structural System Design 2. Structural Health Monitoring and Safety Evaluation 3. Foundation Engineering Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 27 credits units. Of the 27 credits units required, 12 must be core courses, 10 must be elective courses, 3 must be experimental and thematic courses, and 2 must be practical courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
